projects.title: Pump Station 3 telemetry retrofit
projects.summary: Replace the failing telemetry at Pump Station 3 (PS3): a new RTU cabinet, an extended radio link to the Meridian control room, loop checks on every signal, and a changeover procedure issued as revisions (rev A, then rev B).
projects.arc: kickoff -84d; rev A issued -60d; TQ-004 raised -28d; rev B supersedes rev A -21d; loop checks day 1 -12d; day 2 witnessed +3d; commissioning window opens +7d.

projects.title: PS3 standby power study
projects.summary: After the storm night when the PS3 diesel generator failed to start, Meridian asked whether the station can ride through a four-hour grid outage on solar and a battery instead. Load profile, storage sizing, three options, findings due shortly after seed time.
projects.arc: storm outage -50d; study commissioned -45d; logger data from Lena -30d; draft findings -6d; findings review with Gordon +14d.

access.$comment: The four sharing levels, shown the same way in every workspace that can share: a Private folder (admin), a Team folder (shared with the team), a Client folder (shared with clients, here Meridian) and one item at the top level with an open link (public). Embeds only ever point at the same folder tier, so a share never publishes anything the generator did not count.
